༄༅/ /des na bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan la brten nas de'i gdul byas yum don bde blag tu rtogs pa'i rtogs pa de bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan brtsams pa'i dngos kyi dgos pa yin no/ /ngag don rtsa ba bzhin no/ /dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos la rgyas pa la dad pa'i rdon du yum brgyad du phye nas bstan/ bar pa la dad pa'i tshodon du yum drug tu bsdus nas bstan/ bsdus pa la dad pa'i don du yum gsum du bsdus nas bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bsdus don lus rnam gzhag dang / tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po la dgos pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ dgos ldan lus bshad/ bshad pa'i bsdus don bstan / lus rgyas par mi 'grol ba'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ gsungs so/ /gang na yum gyi lus rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /gang gis na shes nas/ brjod kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa bco lngas so/ /ji ltar na tshigs bcad dang po gnyis kyis mdor bstan lhag ma bcu gsum gyis rgyas par bstan nas so/ /dus nam gyi tshe na gong du bstan pa de ltar bstan bcos kyi 'brel pa dang dgos pa la sogs pa bstan nas de'i rjes su'o/ /dgos pa ci'i phyir du na gdul bya nyan pa po rnams kyis rgyas bshad rnams bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'chad pa po rnams kyis lus rnam gzhag la brten nas bstan bcos mngon rtogs

rgyan gyi don rnam par te rgyas par dbye ba byas pa yan lag rgyas bshad yang ma 'dzings par shes pa nyid kyis rgyas bshad kyi gzhung bshad par bya sla bar gzigs nas so/ /ngag don ni/ shes nas/ brjod kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa bco lnga chos can khyed la dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas rgyas bshad kyi gzhung rnams nyan pa pos bde blag tu rtogs shing 'chad pa pos bshad sla bas so/ /gnyis pa la lus mdor bstan/rgyas bshad/ shin tu rgyas bshad do/ /dang po ni/ bshad do/ /gang na lam dang 'bras bu dang gzhung sher phyin ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas so/ /gang la na rgyan gyi gdul bya dbang rtul la'o/ /gang gis na byams pas so/ /ji ltar na skabs brgyad du phye ste yang dag par ro/ /ci'i phyir lam dang gzhung la sher phyin zhes bya zhe na/ lam la 'bras bu dang / gzhung la brjod bya'i ming gis btags la/ 'bras bu ni dngos so/ /phyogs kyi glang pos/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub bya'i don de dang ldan pas/ /gzhung lam dag la de'i sgras gdags / /zhes so/ /dngos po brgyad ni mngon rtogs brgyad yin no/ /btsun pas/ mngon rtogs bdag nyid bdun yin phyir/ /shes rab pha rol phyin zhes bya/ /zhes bshad pas mkhyen pa gsum sbyor ba

༄༅/ /bzhi mngon rtogs/ chos sku mngon rtogs min par mngon no/ /shān+ti pas kyang dang po bdun mngon rtogs/ chos sku min par 'chad de/ ci'i phyir chos kyi sku la mngon par rtogs pa zhes mi bya zhe na/de de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rgyu'i ming gis 'bras bu la btags par bzhed do/ /de mi 'thad de/ mdo las spros pa med cing spros pa thams cad bral ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ khyod la brten nas yum rtogs par 'gyur te/ khyod kyis yum dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log par bshad pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dngos po brgyad gang zhe na/ rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par rtogs pa'i don gnyis mthar thug pa dbye na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i mnyam gzhag dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rjes thob gnyis de'i byang chub phyogs mthun la sogs pa ste sde tshan nyer gcig me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes bzhi'o/ /sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/lam gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i mngon rtogs/ dbye na sa bcu sa mtshams byang sems kyi mthong sgom kho na na yod/ gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi bdag med par mngon

sum du rtogs pa'i blo gang zhig spangs rtogs nyi tshe bar gyur pa/ dbye na nyan rang gi mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum/ sa mtshams kyang de na yod/ rnam rdzogs spyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsdus nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor mthong sgom gyi rnal 'byor rnams dang sbyor ba rnya shu'o/ /sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa btags pa ba yin la/ mtshan nyid pa ni chos sku yin te/ a bha yas/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa btags pa ba ni sbyor ba ste/ mtshan nyid pa ni rnam mkhyen de chos sku'i nang du 'dus pa srid pa dang zhi ba mnyam pa nyid kyi bdag nyid 'bras bu kho na'o/ /zhes dang / mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo spangs pa las/ shes bya la ma chags ma thogs pa rnam kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa nye bar bzung nas bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas kyi sar brjod do zhes so/ /rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bdun/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ mthar gyis pa'i

༄༅/ /sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsdus nas rim gyis sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bcu gsum/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don skad cig ma gcig la rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug /dbye na bzhi/ sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho na na yod/ chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor bzhi bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug /gzhan snang dang tshogs pa'i dbang du byas nas dbye na sku gsum mdzad pa dang bzhi/ sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod/ gsum pa la brgyad las/ dang po rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos ni/ rgyu 'bras ma lus pa thugs su chud pa rnam mkhyen du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ thub pa'i rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstan pa la bcu las/ dang po theg chen gyi sems bsted kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mchungs ldan gyi sems/ dbye na nyer gnyis/sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas so/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi gdams ngag khyad par can gyi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa'i thabs

khyad par can/ dbye na yul gyi sgo nas bcu/ nyan pa po'i sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen po nas rgyan mtha'i sbyor ba'i lam gyi bar na yod/ gsum pa dbu ma pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/rang rgyu tshogs lam las byung ba'i byang sems so skye'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa gang zhig nyan rang gi sbyor lam zlos khyad par du byed chos lngas khyad du 'phags pa/ dbye na nges 'byed yan lag rnam pa bzhi/ bzhi pa theg chen gyi sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa dngos kyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i dri bcas kyi chos dbyings/ dbye na bcu gsum/ sa mtshams rten chos kyi sgo nas bzhag na theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ lnga pa theg chen gyi sgrub pa'i dmigs yul gyi mtshan nyid/ de'i shes byar gyur pa/ dbye na bcu gcig /sa mtshams 'khor 'das kun na yod/ drug pa theg chen gyi sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid/ de'i don du gnyer byar gyur pa/ dbye na gsum/ sa mtshams gtso cher sa dang po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ bdun pa go cha'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/khyad par bzhi ldan gyi sgrub pa gang zhig go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa/ dbye na drug gam so drug /sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ brgyad pa 'jug sgrab kyi ma tshan nyid/

༄༅/ /gang zhig sbor ba'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa/ dbye na dgu/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbor lam nas rgyan mtha'i bar na yod/ dgu pa tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gi dngos 'bras gnas skabs dang rmothar thug gi byang chub chen po rgong rung dngos su skyed pa'i bya ba/ dbye na bcu bdu|/ sa mtsharmerme chos mchog chen po nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ bcu pa nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid / gang zhig 'byung sa brgyad po gang rung du gdon mi za bar 'byin pa'i bya ba/ dbye na brgyad/ sa mtshams dag pa sa na yod/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos la bcu gcig las/ dang po lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ nga rgyal mngon 'gyur ba dang bral zhing rang 'bras lam shes skye ba'i rten du gyur pa/ dbye na 'od mog mog por byed pa dang / sogs pa yul nges pa dang / khyab pa dang / rang bzhin dang /byed snyoms dang lnga/ sa mtshams gtso bor theg chen tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ slob ma nyan thos dang bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyi yon tan yar ldan du skyed cing rang bzhin mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i blo/ sa mtshams lam shes dang 'dra/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ 'jig rten las 'das

pa'i sgom lam ma skyes gong gi byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ dbye na bcu drug sa mtshams sa dang po na yod/ 'dir tshe 'di'i yon tan nad med pa sogs dang / gzhan tshe phyi ma'i yon tan sangs rgyas dang mi 'bral ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pas gong 'og tu bstan pa dang zlos skyon med do/ /theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ de'i 'bras bu yin pa/ dbye na drug /sa mtshams gtso bor sa gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam las skyes pa'i sems dpa'i rjes thob gang zhig /yum don gsum gyis 'byung gnas su nges pa'i sgo nas dang zhing 'khor gsum du mi rtog pa/ dbye na gsum mam dgu'am nyer bdun sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'i rjes thob na yod/ mos pa yid la byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi phan yon bstod pa'i mtshan nyid/ de sbom pa'i yon tan gyi che ba rtogs nas 'dud pa/ dbye na bstod pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye bas bstod pa dang bkur ba dang bsngags pa dang gsum/ sa mtshams gtso cher sa gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa/ dbye

༄༅/ /na bcu gnyis/ sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'i rjes thob na yod/ rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dge ba la dga' ba sgom pa/ dbye na gnyis/ sa mtshams bsngo ba bzhin no/ /theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam las skyes pa'i sems dpa'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam/ dbye na sa lhag ma dgu'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam dgu ngo bo nyid la sogs pa lnga/ sa mtshams kyang de na yod/ theg chen gyi rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam skyes pa'i sems dpa'i mnyam gzhag rnam grol lam/ dbye na sa lhag ma dgu'i rnam grol lam dgu sa mtshams kyang de na yod/ mdor na byang chub sems dpa' theg pa gsum gyi lam gsum la mkhas pa rnams kyi mngon rtogs lam shes pa nyid ni yum lam gsum shes pa de 'drar yul dang ngo bo'i sgo nas bshad do/ /gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos la dgu las/ srid pa la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dus gsum rang bzhin med par mnyam nyid du mngon sum dushes pa'i sems dpa'i mngon rtogs/ zhi ba la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ snying rje chen pos gzhan don byed pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ de gnyis kyi sa mtshams lam

shes dang 'dra/ ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ thabs shes khyad par can dang bral ba'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ sa masgos gzhi shes dang 'dra/ ringe ba ma yinapanye bgyi /sa kyi masno nyid / thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ sa mtshams lam shes dang 'dra/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang mi 'gal ba'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ sa mtshams gzhi shes dang 'dra/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ chos rnams rang bzhin/ med par mngon sum du shes pa'i sems dpa'i mngon rtogs/sa mtshams lam shes dang 'dra/ dngos bstan gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi gzugs sogs la zhen spyod mngon 'gyur ba bkag nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bcu/ sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ dngos bstan gzhi shes rnor ba'i yul can mnyam pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba de dag yul dang yul can du rlom pa mngon 'gyur ba bkag nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bzhi/ sa mtshams sbyor ba dang 'dra/ ga shes kyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ dbye na nyan thos

༄༅/ /dang sogs pa byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyi mthong lam gnyis te/ de 'dra ba rnams dngos brtags ma phye ba'i kun shes nyid du 'dod/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos la bcu gcig las/rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsgom byar gyur pa/ dbye na brgya don gsum/ sa mtshams 'khor 'das kun na yod/ rnam kun gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir rnam pa rnams bsdus nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na nyi shu/ sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ bcas pa ni lhan cig pa rnam kun sbyor ba sgom pa po'i mtshan nyid/ tshogs bsags pas yum nyan pa la sogs pa'i snod du gyur pa'i sems dpa'/ dbye na bzhi/ sa mtshams sbyor ba dang 'dra/ rnam kun gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ de bsgoms pa las byung ba'i phan yon/ dbye na bcu bzhi/ sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ rnam kun gyi sbor ba'i smon gyi mtshan nyid/ de sgom pa la bar du gcod pa'i las/ dbye na zhe drug /sa mtshams gtso bor tshogs sbyor na yod/phra mo sa bdun pa'i bar na yod/ theg cherno sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi 'jog byed/—— /de'i nus pa mtshon par byed pa'am bya ba'i gzhi gang rung du gyur pa'i 'bras bu/ dbye na go gcig /sa mtshams theg chen tshogs

lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i byangachub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyur pa'i byang sems las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs/ dbye na ded wa sogs lnga/ sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam na yod/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir zhes bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu thar pa cha mthun las byung ba'i byang sems so skye'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa gang zhig /sems can la dmigs pa'i rjes thob kyi rnam pa gtso bor gyur pa/ dbye na bzhi/ sa mtshams dbu ma pa'i sbyor lam na yod/ rang nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldo ga par nges pa'i dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid/ rang nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par nges pa'i rjes thob kyi rtags kyi dngos rgyu mnyam gzhag rgyud la skyes pa'i sems dpa'/ dbye na gsum / sa mtshams dbang po rno na sbyor lam 'bring na mthong lam rtul na sa brgyad pa nas nyan rang du lhung gis dogs pa mi 'byung ngo/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas sgom pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ zhing dag pa'i sbor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rang nyid ma

༄༅/ /'ongs pa na sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'i zhing nyes pa med cing yon tan dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir sgom pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na gnyis/ sa mtshams gong ma dang 'dra / thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba'i mtsharno nyid/ stong nyid la sogs pa'i yul bcu mngon sum du bya ba'i dus dang dus ma yin pa shes wa'i thabs la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir sgom pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bcu/ sa mtshams gong dang 'dra/ mdor na thabs mkhas pa dang bcas pa 'di ni rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshon byed yin no/ /rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos la brgyad las drod kyi rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ rtags bcu gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bcu gnyis/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi spyor lam drod na yod/ rtse mo'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam 'phel bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bcu drug /sa mtshams rtse mo na yod/ bzod pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid brtan pa gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na rang don rtogs pa brtan pa dang / gzhan don phrin las brtan pa gnyis/ sa mtshams bzod pa na yod/ chos mchog rtse

sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ sems kun tu gnas pas dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na che 'bring chung ngu gsum/ sa mtshams chos mchog na yod/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam ma skyes gong gi byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs gang zhig /bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa/ dbye na mthong spang rtog pa bzhi'i gnyen po bzhi/ sa mtshams sa dang po na yod/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen mthong lam skyes shing bdag med mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun du goms par byed pa'i sems dpa'i mngon rtogs gang zhig /bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa / dbye na sgom spang rtog pa bzhi'i gnyen po bzhi/ sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu na yod/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug /sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho na na yod/ bsal bya log sgrab kyi mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs rnam la dmigs nas snang stong 'gal bar smra ba'i log rtog /dbye na bcu drug /sa mtshams snang stong 'gal bar smra ba'i dngos smra'i rgyud la yod/ mdor na drod rtse rtegos dang bcas pa dang / rtse mo'i rtse sbyor rnam 'phel dang bcas pa dang / bzod rtse brtan pa dang / chos rtse sems kun tu gnas pa dang / mthong lam dang

༄༅/ /sgom lam rtse sbyor spang bya rtog pa dang / bar chad med rtse log sgrub dang bcas pa ni rtse sbyor mtshon byed yin no/ /mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos la bcu gsum las/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang / dge mi dge lung du ma bstan pa'i chos dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa'i yon tan don dam par yid la mi byed cing kun rdzob tu phyin ci ma log par rim gyis sgom pa'i rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum dang / sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /sher phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab don dam par yid la mi byed cing kun rdzob tu phyin ci ma log par rim gyis sgom pa'i rnal 'byor drug dang / gtong ba dang tshul khrims dang lha rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ sbyin pa gsum gyi yon tan dang sdom pa gsum gyi yon tan dang lhar skyes pa'i 'phags pa'i yon tan don dam par yid la mi byed cing kun rdzob tu phyin ci ma log par rim gyis sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gsum dang / dngos med ngo bo nyid du shes pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rang yul du gyur

pa'i chos rnams ngo bo nyid med par rtogs nas rim gyis sgom pa'i rnal 'byor te rnam pa bcu'o/ /snga ma gsum dang sdom pas bcu gsum mo/ /skad cig ma'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi ni/ rnam par smine pa ra yin pa dang / rnam par smin pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i dge ba'i chos rnams dang / rnam par smin pa'i dge ba'i chos rnams skad cig ma gcig la sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug dang / chos thams cad bden pa'i mtshan nyid med pa dang / chos thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par skad cig ma gcig la sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug /sa mtshams bar chad med rtse dang 'dra/ chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos ni/ brjod do ji ltar na ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i sku ste sku gsum dang / chos sku'i mdzad pa phrin las dang bcas pa rnam pa bzhi ni chos kyi sku mtshon byed yin no zhes yang dag par ro zhes pa ni/ grol sde gnyis dang / a bha ya dang / shān+ti pa dang / rat+na kirti'o/ /slob dpon dang / bud+dha shrī dang / gser gling pa ltar na dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'gog bden mthar thug pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang / gnas 'og min kho nar bzhugs pa'i gzugs kyi sku ni longs spyod rdzogs

༄tsho/ /pa'i sku dang / ngo bo nyid kyi sku ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin pa de bzhin du de las gzhan pa'i sku dag kyang ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin no/ /gdul bya dag ma dag sna tshogs 'dul zheng sku nges med sna tshogs su snang ba'i gzugs kyi sku ni sprul pa'i sku dang / gnas ma lus par gyur pa'i ye shes ni chos kyi sku ste sku bzhi yin la/ chos sku'i bdag rkyen la brten nas rgyun mi 'chad cing lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i las ni chos sku'i mdzad pa phrin las yin la/ de sku'i zhar la bstan pa yin no/ /des na mdzad pa dang bcas pa sku bzhir yang dag par brjod do/ /grol sde gnyis ltar 'thad de/ de ltar min na 'di'i chos sku 'di sku bzhi'i ya rgyal gyi sku gcig yin na/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir 'di'i chos sku dang / chos kyi sku dang de rnams brgyad/ /ces pa'i skabs kyi chos sku la khyab che chung yod par thal lo/ /'dod na rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces pa'i rnam mkhyen dang / lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad/ /ces pa'i lam shes dang / de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /ces pa'i gzhi shes dang / rnam kun mngon rdzogs bcas rme ste'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang / mthar gyis pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang / gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa/ /zhes pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams dang / rnam kun

mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /ces sogs kyi rnam mkhyen lam shes sogs la khyab che chung yod par thal lo/ /'dod na med pas bsal lo/ /gzhan yang yod de re sheg tso go /bshad pa'i bsdus don ni/ lus rnam gzhag la tshigs bcad bco lnga yod pa de la ste de'i nang nas zhes pa nas/ brgyad kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa gnyis chos can/ yum gyi lus mdor bstan pa yin te/yum gyi lus dngos po brgyad du bsdus nas don bdun cu'i thog mar bstan pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed nas/ brjod kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa bcu gsum chos can/ tshigs bcad dang po gnyis la ltos te yum gyi lus rgyas par bshad de/ dngos po brgyad kyi don don bdun cur bsdus nas dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan de ltar shes nas/ brjod kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa bco lnga chos can/ yum gyi lus legs par bshad pa yin te/ bsdus rgyas gnyis kyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log par bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan ma bkrol lo/ /ji ltar na rnam par te rgyas par ro/ /gang na bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bsdus pa'i don lus rnam gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa bco lnga po rnams ni'o/ /gang gis na slob dpon seng ge bzang pos so/ /skabs gang du na 'grel chung 'dir yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gong lus

༄0/ /rnam gzhag gi 'og tu'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan mdzad pa po byams mgon nyid kyis/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i yan lag rgyas bshad kyi bstan bcos mtha' dag gis/ lus rnam gzhag gi tshog le'ur byas pa rnams 'chad pas yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gzhung de dag rnam par te rgyas par bshad pas lus rnam gzhag bshad par bsam zhing 'dir de'i gong du de'i 'grel pa rgyas po gcig byas na/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi 'grel pa dang zlos pa'i nyes par 'gyur du dogs nas so/ /ngag don ni/ 'grel chung don gsal rtsom pa po'i slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ 'grel chung 'dir yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gong du lus rnam gzhag gi 'grel pa rgyas po gcig ma bkrol ba la rgyu mtshan yod de/ yan lag rgyas bshad bshad pas lus rnam gzhag bshad par bsam zhing / 'dir de'i gong du de'i 'grel pa rgyas po gcig bkrol na/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi 'grel pa dang zlos pa'i nyes par 'gyur du dogs nas/ 'dir de'i gong du de'i 'grel pa rgyas po gcig ma bkrol nas so/ /rtags snga ma sgrub pa ni/ chos can/ yan lag rgyas bshad bshad na lus rnam gzhag bshad par 'gyur te/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi bstan bcos kyis lus rnam gzhag 'chad

pas so/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir bdag gis kyang zhib par ma bkrol lo/ /tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad la/ yul mkhyen pa gsum/ rgyu sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang gsum/ dang po la 'bras bu thun mong ma yin pa rnam mkhyen/ rgyu thun mong ma yin pa lam shes/ blang dor thun mong ma yin pa gzhi shes so/ /dang po la rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bshad par bzhed de/ gang na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na rnam mkhyen brjod byar bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang nas/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces pa'i bar rnam par te rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /dus nam gyi tshe na sngar bsten pa de ltar bsdus pa'i don lus rnam gzhag kun bstan pa de'i rjes su'o/ /skabs gang du na skabs brgyad kyi dang por ro/ /de'i khyu mtshan ci zhe na rnam mkhyen thob par bya dgos pas so/ /gang gis na 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan de de'i ched du gnyer bya'o 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ngag don ni/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen chos can/ khyod skabs brgyad kyi dang por bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/

༄༅/ /khyod byang chub sems dpas thob par bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis skabs brgyad kyi dang por bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /chos can khyod des thob par bya dgos te/ khyod de'i ched du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu yen pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ lam gyi rten sems bskyed/ rnam par gzhag pa gdams ngag /sbyor ba nges 'byed cha mthun rgyu rigs/ yul dmigs pa 'bras bu ched du bya ba/ lam rang gi ngo bo sgrub pa dang bdun / dang po la grol sde gnyis/ slob dpon bud+dha shrī ltar na/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dmigs yul/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang bzhi'o/ /yang na 'di bzhin bya ste/ mtshams sbyar/ bsdus don/brgal lan/ tshig don/ dgos don dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos de yang sems bskyed pa la sogs pa bcu las/ dang po sems bskyed pa rang gi ngo bo gang la dmigs pa'i yul dang bcas pa 'chad do/ /thog mar sems bskyed 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sems bskyed pa ni/ dper na 'jig rten pa'i lo thog phun sum tshogs pa la/ dang por myu gu skyed pa la sa bon/ bar du spel ba la chu/ tha mar yun ring du gnas te longs smod pa la smin pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa bzhin du/ de yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i lo thog dang

po skyed pa la sa bon/ bar du spel ba la chu/ mthar longs spyod pa la smin pa lta bu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ shwarnyi pa ltar na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon yin pas so/ /nyi dzakhri gzhunga'agrel ltar nasher phyin la spyod pa la sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed ni gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs lngan gyi sems gcig yin no/ /brgal lan la rgol ba ni/ mdo las gleng gzhi'i 'og tu byang chub mdor bstan rgyas bshad/ gzhan don mdor bstan rgyas bshad de ngag bzhi'i sgo nas sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid rang dang gzhan gyi don rnam pa mang por phye nas bstan pas 'di mdo dang mi mthun no zhe na/ lan ni/ brjod do/ /gang na sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo dang dmigs yul byang chub de dang gzhan don de ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na bsdus pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /ji ltar na mdo las/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub ces sogs kyis sems bskyed dang / de'i yul byang chub bsdus pa dang rgyas par bstan/ phyogs bcu re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed ces sogs kyis sems bskyed dang gzhan don bsdus pa dang rgyas par bstan pa bzhin du/ sems

༄༅/ /bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces sems bskyed dang yul byang chub dang gzhan don bsdus pa dang / de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /zhes sogs kyis de rnams rgyas par bstan no/ /tshig don ni/ de yang sa gser sogs kyis 'chad la/ dgos don ni tshigs bcad 'di rnams la brten nas sems bskyed kyi ngo bo dbye ba dmigs yul rnams bde blag tu rtogs so/ /slob dpon la sogs pa ltar na gzhi'i sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces pa la lnga las/ mtshams sbyar ba ni sngar bzhin no/ /bsdus don ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sems bskyed pa ni gzhan gyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems so/ /tshig don ni/'phags pa ltar na/ 'dod pa ni don gnyer yin pas don du gnyer bar byed pa yin no/ /dus nam gyi tshe na byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dus su'o/ /gang gis na byang chub sems dpas so/ /gang na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /gang gi phyir du na rang sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i sermes can thams cad kyi don mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi phyir du'o/ /brgal lan ni/ /'o na don gnyer de sems

bskyed par mi 'gyur te/ sems bskyed ni yul so sor rig pa gtso bo sems yin la/ 'dod pa don gnyer ni sred pa sems las byung ba yin pas so zhe na/ 'dod pa don gnyer sems bskyed min par tha la 1ba wa bden te 'dod do/ /'o na sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ 'dod pa don gnyer sems bskyed min kyang gzhung dang mi 'gal te / 'dir rgyu don gnyer dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas 'bras bu sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin no/ /'o na de'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa gang zhe na/ rgyu mtshan dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'i mtshan nyid don du gnyer ba yod na sangs rgyas kyi don du sems bskyed par byed pas so/ /dgos pa de ltar bstan pas mdo dang mthun par shes shing gzhan don du byang chub gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i chos thams cad 'phel bar shes so/ /lan gyi rnam grangs gcig tu na/ don gnyer la sems bskyed kyi grogs smon lam yang yod pas grogs smon lam dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas grogs can sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan ni sems bskyed pa'i skabs ni grogs don gnyer gtso che bas so/ /dgos pa de ltar bstan pas grogs smon lam rgyud la yod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la grogs smon lam de

༄༅/ /dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed skye bar shes so/ /des na theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems yin no/ /slob dpon ltar na/ rang nyid rdzogs pa'i thengs rgyas su grub nas gzhan gyi don du skal skro ji lta ba bzhin du 'bad par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed mtshan nyid/ theg chen sems bskyed du mtshon/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /dbye na sems bskyed gzhir byas pa la/ 'gro 'dod pa ltar bsam pas smon pa smon pa dang / 'gro bzhin pa ltar sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pas rdzogs par byed pa 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi ngo bo nyid rnam pa gnyis so/ /chos bshes kyis kyang smon pa ni smon pa tsam ste tshogs bsags pas sems de bskyed pa'i cho gas blangs pa yang ma byas pa'o/ /'jug pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byas te yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i sems bskyed pa nas brtsams te bar chad med pa'i lam gyi bar du gtogs pa'i sgrub pa'i spyod pa'o/ /don 'di ni zhi ba lha'i zhal snga nas/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar

shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes pas sems bskyed gzhir byas pa la 'gro 'dod pa ltar smon pa tsam ni smon pa sems bskyed/ 'gro bzhin pa ltar cho —gas blangs pa nas bar chad med lam gyi bar 'jug pa sems bskyed do/ /sher blos kyang smon pa dang 'jug pa'i mtshan nyi da byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis ka yang gzhan gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa ) byang chub 'dod pa nyid las mi 'da' yang / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las yod pa dang med pa las mtshan nyid tha dad par rtogs par bya'i dmigs pa tha dad ni ma yin te gzhan gyi don dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mos pa'i yul yin pa'i phyir ro gsungs pa yang don snga ma dang 'dra bar mngon no/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kyis smon pa byang chub kyi sems ni 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi yin la/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni sa rab tu dga' ba nas brtsams te'o zhes gsungs shing rngog lo yang de bzhin no/ /bud+dha shis bsam pa smon pa dang / sbor bas 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid rnam pa gnyis rab tu dbye ba dang bcas pa'o zhes gsungs pa yang slob dpon dang mthun par mngon no/ /kha cig byang chub thob par smon pa'i cha nas smon pa/ lam du 'jug bzhin ma'i cha nas 'jug pa yin pas rgyun mtha'i snga logs bar du smon pa sems bskyed yod par 'dod/

༄༅/ /brgal lan la rgol ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa chos can/ khyod sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ khyod byang chub de don du gnyer ba dge ba'i chos byang chub la 'dun pa'i sems byung yin la/ sems bskyed pa ni yul khyad par du 'phags pa gzhan don dang byang chub la dmigs par snang ba can du 'byung ba'i sems yin pas so/ /'dod na rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa chos can/sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa yin pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed chos can 'dod pa ma yin par thal/ sems yin pa'i phyir zhe na lan la rgyus 'bras bu mtshon nas bstan pa dang /grogs kyis grogs can mtshon nas bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni 'dod do/ /'o na/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces pa dang 'gal zhe na kyang gi khongs nas so / /rgyu 'dod pa de sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod na gzhung dang 'gal zhing sem da ge byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa yod pa bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'dir nye bar brtags pa ste rgyu gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas 'bras bu sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin pas de lta bu'i thal 'gyur gyis gnod pa'i nyes pa med do 'o na sems

bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dngos su mi ston par/ rgyu 'dun pa dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas 'bras bu sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gang zhe na/ rgyu mtshan ni mgon skyabs med pa'i sems can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor nub pa la bltas nas de 'don par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dge ba'i chos byang chub la 'dun pa'i mtshan nyid de ngo bo don gnyer yod na 'bras bu byang chub kyi sems bskyed pas de'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /dgos pa ni de ltar bstan pas gzhan don du byang chub don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i chos sems bskyed pa thams cad 'phel bar shes pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos la gnod byed ni/ de dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas de'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ma yin par rgyu 'dun pa de de'i mtshan nyid du bstan pa yin na sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa yod do/ / ngag don ni/ byams mgon chos can/ sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa med de/ rgyu gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas 'bras bu sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid bstan pas so/ /chos can/ de dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas de ston pa yin te/ dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas de ston pa'i chos gsum tshang bas so/ /phyogs gnyis

༄tsho/ /pa ltar na yang 'dod do/ /'o na gzhung dang 'gal lo zhe na/ grogs smon lam de'i mtshan nyid du bkod na gzhung dang 'gal zhing / sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa yod pa bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang lan gyi rnam grangs gcig tu na 'dir nye bar btags pa la brten pa ste grogs smon lam dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas grogs can sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin pas/sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa med do/ /'o na chos gsum po gang zhe na/ rgyu mtshan ni grogs smon lam de dang grogs can sems bskyed gnyis snying rje'i tshogs pa gcig las skye bar mtshungs shing lhan cig spyod pa ste yul gzhan don dang byang chub la dmigs par mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /dgos pa de ltar bstan pas grogs smon lam rgyud la yod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la grogs smon lam dang ldan pa'i grogs can sems bsted ste bar shes pa'i phyir bstan no/ /gnod byed ni dngos su bstan pas mtshon nas de bstan pa min par de de'i mtshan nyid du bstan pa yin na sems byung sems bskyed du bkod pa'i nyes pa yod do/ /'o na grogs sgron khrom de gang zhe na/ grogs smon lam ni gzhan don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba 'dod pa nyid yin no/ /des na theg chen sems bskyed kyi

mtshan nyid ni gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems so/ /mtshungs ldan ni rten dmigs pa rnams pa dus rdzas te mtshungs ldan rnam pa lngas mtshungs pa sems tsam pa 'dod kyang dbu ma pa la rdzaso mtshungs pa med de/ rdzas su grub pa rbe'i rtse mo brgyar bshags pa'i tshad tsam yang ma grub pas so/ /des na 'dir mtshungs ldan bzhis mtshungs te/ grogs gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang grogs can theg chen sems bskyed gnyis/ rten snying rje'i tshogs pa gcig las skye bar mtshungs/ dmigs pa gzhan don dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs par mtshungs/rnam pa rang bzhin med par mtshungs/ dus gcig grub dus na gcig grub par mtshungs so/ /slob dpon gyis 'phags pa grol sde 'phags par bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dang mthun par bkrol lo/ /yang na 'di bzhin bya ste/ rgol ba sngar bzhin no/ /lan ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod ces pa'i 'dod pa de sems byung 'dun pa yin pa rtags ma grub bo/ /'o na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod ces pa dang 'gal zhe na/ 'dod ces pa'i 'dod pa de 'dod pa dngos yin na gzhung dang 'gal zhing sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa yod pa bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang sems bskyed kyi

༄༅/ /mtshan nyid ston pa'i skabs 'dir 'dod pa'i ming gis sems bsted la btags pa yin pas de lta bu'i nyes pa med do/ /'dod pa'i ming gis sems bskyed la btags pa la/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags pa dang / grogs ming grogs can la btags pa gnyis/ dang po ni/tsho rgyu gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa'i ming gis 'bras bu sems bskyed la btags nas bstan pa yin te / 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa sngar bzhin 'bras bu gzhan don mdzad do/ /dngos la gnod byed bden mod ces par bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lan gyi rnam grangs gcig tu na grogs gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i smon lam de'i sgras grogs can sems bskyed la btags nas bstan pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan dgos pa gnod byed sngar bzhin mdzod/ /'dod pa'i ming gis sems bskyed la btags pa ltar na/ 'dod ces pa'i 'dod pa de ming 'dod pa don sems bskyed yin dgos te/ don sems bskyed ma yin par 'dod pa yin na/ 'dod pa'i ming gis sems bskyed la btags pa 'gal lo/ /dper na mi glen pa la ba glang zhes btags pa bzhin no/ /a bha ya ltar na sems bskyed pa ni mtshon bya yin la/ lhag ma ni mtshan nyid do/ /sems ni rnam par rig pa ste rnam par shes pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa

ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa de la srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir sems dang yid dang 'dod pa dang 'dun pa dang mos pa dang don du gnyer ba rnams ni rnam grangs so/ /de ltar yang 'gro bar 'dod nas brjod pa bdag gi sems 'gro bar 'dod ces sems la 'dod par brjod pa dang / bdag gi yid 'gro bar 'dod ces yid la 'dod par brjod pa bzhin te/ sems dang yid la sogs pa de skyed pa ni sems bskyed pa'o/ /gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don phan pa nas bla med byang chub kyi ched du gnyer ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod cing mos pa dang lhag pa'i sems te/ mdor na don gnyer dang lhan cig spyod pa'i sems kyi khyad par stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa byang chub kyi sems kyi gzhan don dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /'o na don du gnyer ba ni rtog pa ste/ de dang lhan cig rgya ba'i sems de bcom ldan 'das la yod dam zhe na/ bden te don du gnyer ba la don du gnyer bar byed pa dang don du gnyer bar byas zin pa gnyis las don du gnyer bar byas zin pa'i sems rnam par rtog pa mede pa kho na bcom ldan 'das la yod do/ yan+ti pa ltar na gzhan gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid

༄༅/ /do / /dgos don ni/ 'di la brten nas sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid bde blag tu rtogs pa'o/ /dmigs yul ni/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod/ /ces gsungs pa la yang lnga las mtshams sbyar ba ni/ mtshan nyid la skyon yod par ma zad/ yang 'dod pa'i bdag nyid ni gang yin/ dgos pa gang gi don du sems bskyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub de ni gang yin/ gzhan gyi don gang yin mdo dang mthun par brjod do zhe na/ dri zhes pas mtshams sbyar nas bsdus don dang tshig don gyi sgo nas lan 'debs pa la bsdus don ni/ brjod do/ /gang na 'dod pa dang byang chub de dang gzhan don de ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na bsdus pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /ji ltar na mdo nas bshad pa bzhin du'o/ /byams mgon chos can/ sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul rnams rang dgar bstan pa ma yin te/ de rnams mdo nas bshad pa bzhin du bstan pas so/ /tshig don ni/ 'phags pa dang 'grel chen dang shān+ti pa ltar na byang chub de dang gzhan don de ni yum gyi mdo nas bshad pa bzhin du bstan bcos 'dir bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod do/ /rata kir ltar na bcom ldan 'das kyis yum gyi mdor sems bskyed de dang de ni bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas yang dag par rdzogs

pa'i byang chub 'dod pa la bshad de de yang gzhan gyi don du gsungs so/ /de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bstan bcos 'dir mdo bzhin te mdo dang rjes su mthun par byas kyi rang dgar ni ma yin no/ /—'egrel chung ltar na brjod pa ste bstan no/ /gang na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub de dang gzhan gyi don de ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na bsdus pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /ji ltar na dkon mchog sna bdun dang sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa'i mdo'i don dang mi 'gal bar ro/ /gang las na dkon mchog sna bdun sogs las bshad par ma zad rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnam pa gsum car las kyang ngo / mdo tshig gang gis na shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'dod pas yum la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes pa byang chub bsdus nas bstan pa ste dmigs rnam ma phye bar byang chub bstan pas so/ /ar gyi'o/ /yang na phyin drug so sor ma phye bar yum du bsdus nas bstan pas so/ /spyin pa la sogs pa thams cad la sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa ni/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis yum la gnas te sbyin par bya ba dang sbyin pa po dang len pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ /yongs su gtong ba med pa'i tshul gyis smin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub par

༄༅/ /bya'o / /sogs pa lhung ba dang mi lhung ba med pa'i phyir tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / zhabrug pa med pa'i phyir bzod pa dang / lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa'i phyir brtson 'grus dang / ro myong ba med pa'i phyir bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang shes rab 'chal ba mi dmigs pa'i phyir yum bsgrub par bya'o zhes byang chub shes par byed pa'i don can gyi ngag gis byang chub rgyas par bshad de dmigs rnam phye nas byang chub bstan pa'o/ /yang na phyin drug so sor phye nas bslab tshul dang bcas pa bstan pas so/ /gzhan don rab tu ston pa lhur len pa'i ngag shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang sems chen po nas / phyogs bcu re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can ji snyed yod pa de thams cad skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las zlo bar 'dod pas yum bsgrub par bya'o zhes pas gzhan don mdor bstan te/ sems can myang 'das la 'god pa'i thabs ma phye bar bsdas nas bstan pas so/ /de bzhin du sems can ser sna can rnams sbyin pa dang / sogs pa tshul khrirmes 'chal ba rnams sogs pa tshul khrims dang / gnod sems mang ba rnams bzod pa dang / le lo can rnams brtson 'grus dang / sems rnam par g.yeng ba can rnams bsam gtan

dang / shes rab 'chal ba rnams shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la 'god par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen pos yum bsgrab par bya'o zhes pas gzhan don rgyas bshad de/ sems can myang 'das la 'god pa'i thabs so sor phye nas bstan pas so/ /mdo don bkrol na gnod 'joms nas ma shā ri yin pas na shā ri'i bu sher phyin bstano pa 'di la byang chub sems dpa' la kun rdzob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bden pa gnyis la gnas te shes rab dang snying rje gnyis kyi sems rin po che skyed pa dang ldan pa'i tshogs sbyor ba rnams dang / don dam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ chos thams cad ni ji snyed pa rnam pa thams cad ni ji lta ba mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis/ chos la kun btags pa'i chos dang yongs su grub pa'i chos rnams la kun rdzob kyi rnam pa dang don dam pa'i rnam pa gnyis/ de la kun btags pa'i chos 'jig rten gsum du gtogs pa dang dus gsum du gtogs pa rnams kun rdzob kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas thams cad shes pa'i ye shes kyis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub yongs su grub pa'i chos rnams 'jig rten las 'das pa skye ba med pa dang 'gag pa med pa dang gzod ma nas zhi ba la sogs pa'i rnam par rnam pa thams cad mkhyen

༄༅/ /pa'i ye shes kyis mngon par byang chub/ yum ni smon lam dang brtson 'gyus brtsams pa dang nyon mongs pa dang las dang sdug bsngal dang 'khor ba dang rnam par rtog pa dang yon tan dang shes par bya ba ste / rnam pa 'di dgu'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes rnerme par mi rtog pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus pa la yum zhes bya'o/ /me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes rnams kyang de'i rgyu las byung bas 'bras bu la rgyu btags te yum zhes bya'o/ /nyan rang gi mthar phyin pa'i sas bsdus pa dgra bcom pa'i ye shes kyang yum gyi rgyu mthun pa yin pas yum zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mos spyod nas chos kyi sprin gyi bar la yang yum gyi ming thob bo/ /gzhung la yang yum zhes brjod pa de dag las 'dir ni sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i shes rab 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa la yum zhes bya'o zhes gsungs/ slob dpon gyi 'grel par de yang shes rab ces bya ba chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi yum ni yum ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu ni dngos yin la/ de thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid kyis na tshig dang ngag gi tshogs kyi gzhung dang mthong lam la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi lam la yang yum zhes bya ba ni btags pa ba'o zhes gsungs pa'i don

gzhung lam 'bras bu gsum ka 'di skabs kyi yum yin yang / yum mtshan nyid pa 'bras bu'i yum yin la gzhan gnyis btags pa ba yin no/ /'di 'thad do/ /mdor na chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas yum mngon par rtogs pa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la bslab par bya zhes so/ /sgrub byed dang bcas pa mang bas ma bris so/ /rgyu mtshan de ltar na theg chen sems bskyed ni gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs nas mngon par zhen pa med pa sgyu ma ltar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i bdag nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ /ngag don ni/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang / mtshungs ldan gyi dkar po'i yid shes chos can/ theg chen sems bsted yin te/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs lngan gyi sems yin pas so/ /brgal lan la rgol ba ni/ gal te byang chub dang gzhan don mdo gzhan rnams las gsangs na 'dir shes byed kyi khongs su 'bri bar rigs so zhe na/ lan ni/ gtsug lag gi gzhung ste mdo skabs kyi don byang chub dang gzhan don ston pa lhur len pa ni sdong po

༄༅/ /bkod pa la sogs pa las bstan par ma zad/ rgyas 'bringabasdus pa thams cad las kyang gsungs mod kyi tshig mang du dogs nas mdo'i don thams cad shes byed kyi khungs nyid du ma bris pa yin gyi/brjod mi nus pa'am mdo las ma gsungs pas ma bris pa ma yin no/ /ngag don ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ 'dir sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul ston pa'i mdo tshig thams cad ma bris pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshig mang du dogs nas 'dir de thams cad ma bris pas so/ /dbye ba ni/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang / /zhes sogs kyis gsungs ba la gsum las mtshams sbyar ba ni/ /gong du bstan pa de ltar sems bskyed pa dmigs pa dang rang gi ngo bo dang bcas pa brjod nas/ skabs su bab pa da ni sems bskyed pa de'i rab tu dbye ba rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyi sgo nas 'chad do/ /lus rnam gzhag tu don gyis thob pa dngos su ma bstan pa'i don gcig 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i tshigs bcad ni bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad de 'og ma kun yang de bzhin no/ /bsdus don ni/ sems bskyed tsam zhig dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /tshod pa'i rgyu mtshan mtshon byed dpe nyi shu rtsa gnyig yod pal

so / /ngag don ni/ sems bskyed chos can/ khyod la nyi shu rtsa gnyis su 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod mtshon byed kyi dpe nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nyi shu rtsa gnyis su phye ba'i phyir ro/ /yang gi don ni sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang dmigs yul rnams mdo bzhin du brjod par ma zad dbye ba de yang mdo bzhin du brjod ces pa'o/ /tshig don ni/ mtha'i ldan pa ni zhes pa grogs kun gyi mjuspru/ tu sbyar/mtha'i lta bu ni dpe kun gyi mjug tu sbyar/ /nyid kyi zhes pa chos mthun kun gyi mjug tu sbyar la grangs bzhin du 'chad pa ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'dun pa tsam dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed ni / sa lta bu yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan sas 'jig rten pa'i lo tog phun sum tshogs pa skye ba'i gzhi byed pa bzhin du/ des kyang rang 'bras chos dkar po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang de'i rgyu tshogs thams cad kyi gzhi byed pas so/ /bsdu na/ de chos can/ sa lta bu yin te rang 'bras chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi byed pas so/ /de bzhin du 'og ma kun la'ang mdzod cig /sngar gyi 'dun pa'i steng du phar phyin drug gi sgo nas gdul bya rnams la tshe 'di nyid la phan pa dang / phyi ma la bde bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan ni/ gser bzang po lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan gser bzang po bsregs pa dang bcad pa dang

༄༅/ /brdar ba la sogs byas kyang ngo bo ngan du mi 'gro ba de bzhin du/ 'di yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du phan bde'i bsam pa mi 'gyur zhing gnas pas so/ /sngar gyi steng du gdul byas byang chub phyogs mthun sogs rtogs par 'dod pas sngar gyi bsam pa bas lhag pas na lhag pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan ni/ yar ngo'i zla ba tshes pa lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan yar ngo'i zla ba tshes pa ni dkar phyogs 'phel zhing nag phyogs 'grib pa bzhin du/ 'di yang dge ba'i chos dran pa nyer gzhag sogs mthar thug gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin pas so/ /des na 'dun pa dang bsam pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / gsum ni gang du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa chung ngu 'bring chen po yin te/ gser gling pas 'dun pa dang bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa ni gzhan gyi don mngon par 'dod pa chung ngu 'bring chen po'o zhes pa bzhin no/ /gzhi shes shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba dang / lam shes yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rnam mkhyen rjes su thob par bya ba'i phyir du mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyi shes pa'i don bsdus nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ mkhyen gsum yul du byas nas sgom pas na mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba ste/ mdor na mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba dang mtshungs ldan ni/ me lta bu yin te/

rgyu mtshan mes bud shing sreg pa bzhin du/ des kyang rang gi spang bya gzhi shes shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba dang / lam shes rdzogs par byed pa dang / rnam mkhyen rjes su thob par byed pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa ni mkhyen gsum gyi sgrib pa ste/ mdor na rang gi spang bya sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg pas so/ /spyin pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni gter chen po lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan gter chen pos zang zing mi zad par byed pa bzhin du/ des kyang rang gi gdul bya sems can thams cad zang zing gi longs spyod kyis tshim par byed cing longs spyod zad mi shes pas so/ /tshul khrims kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs kyi gnas lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan rin po che 'byung khungs bzhin du/ de yang rang 'bras yon to rin po che'i rten byed pas so/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ rgya mtsho chen po lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan rgya mtsho chen po yang chung ba phye ma leb dang che ba 'dab chags khyung la sogs pas g.yo bar mi nus pa bzhin du/ de la yang mi 'dod pa mtshon dang me dang mi la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad thog tu bab pas kyang yid mi 'brugs pas so/ /brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan des brag la sogs pa'i dngos po rnams 'joms shing tshur mi tshugs

༄༅/ /pa bzhin du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgya 'bras la yid ches pa brtan po thob pas bdud dang bdud las kyis mi phyed cing de rnams 'joms par nus pas so/ /bsam gtan gyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni / ri'i rgyal po lhun po lta bu yin te/ rgyu marten ri'i rgyal po yang phye ma leb dang khyung la sorges pas bskyod par mi nus pa bzhin du/ de yang mtshan mar dmigs pa'i rnam par g.yeng bas bskyod par mi nus pas so / /rgyan las/ phye ma leb dang 'dab chags dang / /rgya mtsho dag gis ri rab ltar/ /brtan pa grogs ngan sdug bsngal dang / /zab mo thos pas mi g.yos so/ /zhes so/ /shes rab kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ sman chen po rtsi'i rgyal po mthong na dga' lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan rtsi'i rgyal po mthong na dga' mthong ba tsam gyis nad zhi bar byed pa bzhin du/ des kyang rang gi spang bya nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pas so/ /thabs mkhas pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen des gdul bya yal bar mi 'dor ba bzhin du/ des kyang gnas skabs thams cad du tshad med bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong par sgrub pas so/ /smon lam gyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor

bu bzang po lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan yid bzhin gyi nor bu la gsol ba btab na bsam pa dang mthun pa'i dgos 'dod 'grub pa bzhin du des kyang yid kyis ji ltar smon pa bzhin du 'bras bu 'grub par byed pas so/ /stobs kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ nyi ma lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan nyi mas lo tog smin par byed pa bzhin du/ des kyang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya yongs su smin pa byang chub thob par byed pas so/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ni/ sbyin pa ni zang zing gi dngos po sbyin pa'o/ /snyan par smra ba ni phar phyin drug gi chos ston par byed pa'o/ /don spyod pa ni phyin drug yang dag par len du 'jug pa'o/ /don mthun pa ni gzhan len du 'jug pa de la bdag nyid kyang rjes su 'jug par byed pa'o/ /de ltar mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyin mtshungs de ston len 'jug dang / /bdag nyid rjes su 'jug rnams kyis/ /snyan par smra dang don spod dang / /don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /ye shes kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni/ dri za'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan pa lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan dri za'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs kyis dri za rnams 'edun par byed pa bzhin du/ de las kyang so so yang dag rig bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya 'dun par byed pa'i chos ston pa 'byung bas so/ /mngon par shes pa drug dang mtshungs ldan ni/ rgyal po chen

༄༅/ /po lta bu yin te/ rgyal po rang gi 'khor gyi dgos pa sgrub pa la thogs pa med pa bzhin du/ des kyang rton pa bzhis mthu thogs pa med pa'i sgo nas gzhan gyi don sgrub pas so/ /rten pa bzhe n-i/don la rton gyi tshig 'bru la ma yin te/ don ngan na tshig snyan yang dgos pa med la/ don bzang na tshig mi snyan yang dgos pa dang bcas pa'o/ /des na phal pa'i skad du dam pa'i chos ston yang gus par nyan par bya'o / /chos la rton gyi gang zag la ma yin te/ dam pa'i chos spros bral mi shes na gang zag bzang ba ltar snang yang snying po med la/ spros bral rtogs na gang zag ngan pa ltar snang yang snying po dang bcas pas so/ /des na gang zag phal pa'i tshul du snang yang nges don zab mo khong du chud cing ston na gus pas bla mar bsten par bya'o/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde la rton gyi drang ba'i don gyi mdo sde la ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das ni tshad ma mchog tu gyur pas so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab ni ye shes/ 'jig rten pa'i thos pa dang bsam pa las byung ba'i shes pa ni rnam shes te/ des na ye shes la rton gyi rnam shes la ma yin te/ye shes kyis rtogs pa gang yin pa de rnam par shes pas mthong ba ma yin no/ /rton pa'i don snying por byed pa'o/ /sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pa'i phar phyin bsod nams kyi tshogs/ shes rab kyi phar phyin

ni ye shes kyi tshogs te/ rgyan las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi/ /zhes dang / dbu ma 'jug pa las/ sbyin sogs chos gsum de dag phal mo cher/ /bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag nyid/ /ces so/ /mdor na tshogs gnyis dang mtshungs ldan ni/ rdzas mang po bzhag pa'i bang mdzod lta bu yin te/rgyu mtshan bang mdzod rdzas mang po'i gnas yin pa bzhin du/ de yang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mang po'i mdzod yin pas so/ /byang phyogs so bdun dang mtshungs ldan ni/ lam po che lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan lam po che ni gang zag rnams 'gro 'ong byed pa'i lam yin pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang 'phags pa 'das pa dang da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams gshegs shing ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du gshegs pa'i lam yin pas so/ /snying rje dang lhag mthong dang mtshungs ldan ni/ bzhon pa rta cang shes lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan rta cang shes kyis bgrod pa'i gnas su bde blag tu phyin par byed pa bzhin du/ 'di yang thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gang du yang mi lhung ba'i sgo nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su bde blag tu 'gro bas so/ /chos kyi tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin pa dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs

༄༅/ /ldan ni gzungs/ chos kyi tshig don gzhan la ston par nus pa ni spobs pa ste/ mdor na gzungs spobs gnyis dang mtshungs ldan ni/ chu gting nas 'byon par byed pa bkod ma'i chu lta bu yen te/rgyu mtshan bkod ma'i chus chu mi zad par 'byin pa bzhin du/ 'dis kyang sngar thos pa dang sngar ma thos pa thos 'gyur gyi chos 'dzin pa'i sgo nas mi zad par byed pas so/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi bstan pas gdul bya dga' bar byed pas na chos kyi dga' ston te/ mdor na chos kyi sdom bzhi sgrogs pa'i dga' ston dang mtshungs ldan ni/ kun dga'i sgra snyan pa lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan kun dga'i sgra thos nas bdud rtsis tshim par byed pa bzhin du/ 'di la brten nas thar pa byang chub chen po 'dod pa'i gdul bya la sdom bzhi'i snyan pa spogs par byed pas so/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi ni 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag /zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal / chos thams cad bdag med/ mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad zhi ba'o/ /mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob kyis yul la 'jug pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i rnam par gcig pas na bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mthar thug pa dang mtshungs ldan ni/ chu bo'i rgyun lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan chu bo'i rgyun las chu rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab pa bzhin du/ 'dis kyang thabs shes khyad par canagyi sgo nas gzhan gyi don bya ba tha mi dad pa ste

lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad du byed pas so/ /chos kyi ska bya ba grwab pa'i ye shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bsted ni/ char smin gyi tshogs lta bu yin te/ rgyu mtshan char sprin gyi tshogs lame lo tog sminapar byed pa'i char 'bab pa bzhin du/ 'di yang thabs mkhas parā sgo na༄ gdul bya smin pa'i don du dga' ldan gyi gnarme na bzhugs par nas 'dir 'pho ba dang / lhums su 'jug pa dang bltams pa sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston par rung ba ste nus pa nyid kyis so/ /mdor na bya grub ye shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed chos can/ sprin lta bu yin te/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston par nus pas so/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol ba dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /ces so/ /mjug bsdu ba ni/ de yang sa gser zla ba me zhes sogs kyi tshogs bcad gnyis chos can/ sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis bshad pa yin te/

༄༅/ /sems bskyed kyi grogs dang dpe dang chos mthun nyer gnyis bstan pa de ltar na ste de'i phyir yang sems bskyed la dbye na brda las byung ba dang don dam sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang zag gzhan gyis bstan cing gzhan gyi rnam par rig byed las byung ba'o/ /de ltar rgyan las/ gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces dang / de'i 'grel par gzhan gyis bstan cing gzhan gyi rnam par rig byed las sems bskyed pa gang yin pa de ni yang dag par blang ba brda las byung ba zhes bya'o/ /sa mtshams gtso cher tshogs sbyor na yod/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zhig /chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ de ltar rgyan las/ chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ /ces so/ /sa mtshams sa dang po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ nyer gnyis po'i sa mtshams ni/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis yod pa de la ste de'i nang nas dang po gsum ni theg chen gyi las dang po pa'i thar pa cha mthun gyis bsdus te de gsum tshogs lam gyi spyod yul yin no/ /ji ltar na dang po 'dun ldan sems bskyed ni tshogs lam chung ngu dang gnyis pa bsam ldan ni 'bring dang gsum pa lhag pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed ni tshogs lam chen po nyid kyis bsdus so/ /de'i don sems bskyed dang

po theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas gnyis pa 'bring gsum pa chen po nas yod ces pa'o/ /ngag don ni/ tshogs lam chung ngu la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la 'dun ldan sems bskyed yod de / khyod gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i sems dpa' yin pas so/ /phyi ma gnyis des rigs 'gre'o/ /gsum po de'i 'og tu sbyor ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed pa gcig ni sa dang po la 'jug pa'i lam theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyis bsdus pa ste/ sbyor ba'i lam gyi spyod yul yin no/ /ngag don ni/ stor lam la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ /khyod kyi rgyud la sbyor ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed yod de/ khyod dbang du bya ba'i phyir du mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsdus nas sgom pa'i byang sems yin pas so/ /bzhi po de'i 'og tu phar phyin bcu dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed bcu ni sa rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa sa bcus bsdas te/ dang po mthong lam dang lhag ma rnams sgom lam gyi spyod yul yin no/ /ji ltar bsdus na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni sa dang po dang / tshul khrims kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni sa gnyithe pa dang / /bzod pa'i dang mtshungs ldan ni sa gsum pa/ brtson 'grus dang mtshungs ldan ni sa bzhi t+pa/ bsam gtan gyi ni sa lnga pa/

༄༅/ /shes rab kyi ni sa drug pa/ thabs kyi ni sa bdun pa/ smon lam dang stobs dang ye shes kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan ni sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa dang bcu pas bsdus so/ /de'i don sems bskyed de rnams sa de rnams na gtso cher yod pa yin te/ sa dang por sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gtso cher spyod pas so/ /de bzhin sa gnyis pa sogs rigs 'gre'o/ /bcu bzhi po de'i 'og tu mngon shes dang tshogs gnyis dang byang chub phyogs mthun dang snying rje lhag mthong dang / gzungs spobs dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed pa lnga ni khyad par gyi lam dag pa sas bsdus so/ /a bha yas/ de lnga dang chos kyi dga' ston dang mtshungs ldan dang drug ni sa bcu pa'i khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus zhes bshad do/ /chos bshes kyis sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyis mngon shes sogs lngas bsdus zhes bshad do/ /de lnga yang lam de na gtso cher yod kyi gzhan na med pa ma yin no/ /bcu dgu po de'i 'og tu chos kyi dga' ston dang / bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam ngang chos kyi sku dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed gsum ni sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus te/ mi slob lam gyi spyod yul yin no/ /ji ltar bsdus na/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jug pa'i spyor ba dang / gnyis pa sangs rgyas sa'i dngos gzhi mnyam gzhag dang / gsum pa mjug rjes thob kyis so/ /

mjug bsdu ba ni/ tshul de ltar na sems bskyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba nyer gnyis ni las dang po pa'i sa nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyis bsdus te/ sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod pa yin no/ /ngag don ni/sems bskyed kyi dbye ba chos can/ las dang po pa'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod de/ theg chen gyi lam lnga na yod pas so/ /rata kir slob dpon dang 'dra/ bud+dhā shrī dang po bcu bzhi slob dpon dang 'dra / phyi ma brgyad ni de'i 'og tu bzhi dang gnyis dang gnyis ni sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa dang bcu pas bsdus so zhes gsungs/ a bha yas dang po gsum smon pa/ phyi ma bcu dgu 'jug pa sems bskyede du bzhed do / /'phags pas bgrod pa gcig pa ni sa der gtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ gzhan gyi don bya ba tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /sher 'byung blo gros kyis rab tu dbye ba khyad par med par brjod pa de lta na yang 'jug pa kho na'i yin gyi/ smon pa'i ni ma yin te/ de la ni sa'i dbye bas khyad par srid pa'i phyir dang / gzhan la ni 'dun pa tsam nyid kyis thams cad la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pas nyer gnyis po thams cad 'jug pa sems bskyed yin par bzhed do/ /slob dpon skal ldan gyis 'dun sogs gsum gyis dbye ba las smon pa'i sems ni rnam pa gsum 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i sems

༄tsho/ /rnams ni bcu dgu rnams su 'dod pa yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa rnams par dag pa'i gdams ngag ni/ sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs dkon rma chog ga sum/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa la lnga las/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ sems bskyed bshad zin nas de'i rjes su gdamasdo/ ngag 'chad do/ /de gang las shes zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das byang sems chen po ji lta ra yum la spyad par bgyi zhes gsungs pa las shes so/ /yang na/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces pas sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo gtso bor bstan cing / ngo bo'i gnas skabs tsam la rab tu dbye bar bzhag pas na/ sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo'i zhar la dbye ba brjod nas/ de'i rjes su gdams ngag 'chad pa la 'doms so/ /gang la na sngar bshad pa de ltar byang chub kyi sems dang po 'dun ldan dang / sogs pa bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bsted pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa la'o/ /dus nam gyi tshe na 'doms pa ji lta ba bzhin du gdams ngag don du gnyer bar byed pa'i dus na'o/ /dgos pa ci'i phyir du na chos bshes ltar na rgyu'i byang chub kyi sems bsgyed dang rgyu des 'phangs pa'i chos 'bras bu'i sems bskyed dang / sangs rgyas kye sa la sogs pa sngar ma thob pa thob rung

rnam sa grub par bya ba'i phyir dang / gser ltar na byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang sems bskyed des 'phangs pa'i chos chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi'i dngos po dang / byang chub kyi bar du mi 'gyur ba la sogs pa 'grub par bya ba'i phyir dang / yon tan thob zin pa rnams mi nyams patshor yongs su bsrung rbe'i don gyis te dbang gis gong nas gong du mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /gang gis na sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i skus so/ /mdor na tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems la/ gdams ngag don du gnyer bar byed pa'i dus su thob rung gi yon tan thob par bya ba dang thob zin gyi yon tan 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir du/sangs rgyas kyis 'doms so/ /ngag don ni/ tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ 'dir bstan gdams ngag nyan pa la dgos pa yod de/ de nyan pas rang rgyud kyi yon tan thob zin 'phel zhing thob rung gi yon tan thob par 'gyur bas so/ /bsdus don ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa'i thabs de theg chen gdams ngag tsam yin la/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa'i thabs khyad par can gang zhig /chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin thob pa de 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can gyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ gdams pa dang rjes bstan gnyis/ dang po ni/

༄༅/ /gang zhig thob zin pa'i yon tan 'phel bar byed pa'i thabs/ gnyis pa ni/ gang zhig thob rung gi yon tan thob par byed pa'i thabs/ de ltar 'phags pas de la don du gnyer ba'i don thob pa'i bya ba nye bar ston pa ni gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa yin te thob zin pa'i yon tan yongs su skyong ba'i don gyis mi nyams pa bskyed pa ni gdams ngag yin la/ de'i 'og tu ma thob pa'i yon tan thob par byed pa'i phyir na/ rjes su bstan pa yin no zhes so/ /de gnyis la yang byed pa po la yod pa dang / /bya ba las la yod pa'i gdams pa dang rjes bstan gnyis gnyis yod de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can nyan pa po ni/ tshogs lam chen po nas rgyun mtha'i sbyor ba'i lam gyi bar na yod do tshogs lam chen po man chad kyis mi nyan te/ chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin ma thob pas so/ /'di nyan pa la chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin thob dgos te/ rgyan las/ de tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la zhi gnas dang / ye shes yangs pa thob bya'i phyir/ /gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin btags pa'i dngos po lasems rtse gcig pa gang zhig chos 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang mtshungs ldan no/ /de tshogs lam chen po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod do/ /'dir bstan gdams ngag ni don du

gnyer ba'i tshe gdams pa yin pas/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam na nyan pa po med de/ de don du gnyer ba med pa'i phyir te/ der rang byung gi ye shes dngos su bskyed nus pas so/ /de ltar chos bshes kyis bar chad med lam gyi bar la ni don du gnyer ba med de/ rang byung gi ye shes bskyed par nus pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /yang yul gyi sgo nas dbye na theg chen gyi gdams ngag dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo sgrub pa dang bden pa dang dkon mchog dang ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus dang mi ngal ba dang lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus dang spyan dang mngon shes dang mthong lam dang sgom lam la 'doms nga 'i gdams ngag dang rnamapa bcu'i bdag nyid do/ /dbye don ngo bo gcig la 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yul bcu yod pas so/ /grangs nges ni byang chub sems dpa'i don phun sum tshogs bsgrub pa la bcu po 'di bas mang yang mi dgos la nyung na yang mi rdzogs pa'i phyir bcur grangs nges so/ /bcu po'i go rim ji lta bu zhe na/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bsted nas de'i rjes su nyams su blang dgos pas sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya rnams thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas nyams su longs shig ces slob pa sgrub pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag bstan/ yang na sems bstorde pa'i skabs su yum la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ji ltar yum la bslab par bya zhe na/ spyod pa po byang

no༅2/ /sems / spyad bya yum/ spyad 'bras byang chub/ shes bya phung po lnga rnams mi dmigs par rtogs la yum nyams su longs shig ces lung 'bogs pa sgrub pa la 'doms pa bstan te/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya rnams thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sno nas nyams su len pa'i spyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i spyad pa bya ba'am spyod pa po byang sems sogs yang dag par mi dmigs par rtogs nas yum nyams su len pa'i spyod pa gtso bor gyur pa bya ba theg chen sgrub pa'i ngo bo yin no/ /de lta bu'i sgrub pa nyams su len pa la dmigs yul dgos pas dmigs yul bden pa bzhi po rnams la shes bya shes byed kyi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs la shes par gyis shig ces slob pa sdug bden la 'doms pa dang skye 'gag dang spang gnyen sogs dang ldan pa'i chos can du ma grub par rtogs la spongs shig ces slob pa kun 'byung bden pa la 'doms pa dang / yin lugs la kun nas nyon mongs pa spyi bye brag dang / rnam byang spyi bye brag tu ma grub par rtogs la mngon du gyis shig ces slob pa 'gog bden la 'doms pa dang brtson bya brtson byed bsgom bya sgom byed nges 'byin yin min spros bral du rtogs la rgyud la bsten cig ces slob pa lam bden la 'doms pa bstan no/ /dmigs yul bden pa rnams la dmigs nas smrab pa nyams su len pa la skyabs su 'gro dgos pas rten skyabs su

'gro ba'i yul dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa bstan no/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ste dmigs yul bden pa rnams la dmigs nas sgrub pa nyams su len pa na gegs le lo gsum 'byung srid pas de'i gnyen por gegs sel ba la brtson 'grus gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag bstan/ brtson 'grus gsum gyi shegs bsal nas sgrub pa nyams su blangs ba ni yon tan spyan lnga dang mngon shes drug la zhen pa 'byung srid cing de rnams la zhen na 'ching bas/ de rnams la zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir du de gnyis la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag bstan no/ /de ltar 'doms pa'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs pas sgrib pa mngon 'gyur 'gags shing spangs kyang sgrib pa'i sa bon ma spangs pas de spang bar bya ba'i phyir du mthong sgom la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag bstan no/ /mdor na dang po gsum tshogs lam du de nas lnga sbyor lam du gtso cher nyams su len la/ mthong sgom la 'doms pa gnyis/ mthong sgom du nyams su len pas don gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas nas bstan no/ /slob dpon ltar na tshig don gyi rjes su 'chad do/ /yang na shes par bya'o / /gang na theg chen gyi gdams ngag ni ji ltar na grangs bcu'i bdag nyid du'o/ /bcu po gang zhe na sgrub pa la 'doms pa nas/ sgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi bar ro/ /ngag don ni/

༄༅/ /gdams ngag chos can/ khyod la bcur 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ yul bcu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bcur phye nas so/ /tshig don la bcu las/ dang po sgrub pa la 'doms pa ni/ 'doms so / /gang gis na sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i skus so/ /yul gang la na theg chen gyi sgrub pa la'o/ /slob ma gang la na tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems la'o/ /dus nam gyi tshe na gdams ngag don du gnyer ba'i dus de'i tshe na'o/ /dgos pa ci'i phyir du na mthar thug rnam mkhyen thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / gnas skabs thob zin gyi yon tan 'phel ba dang / thob rung gi yon tan thob par bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /tshul ji ltar na yul kun rdzob dang don dam bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' bas/ yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas 'jug par bya'o zhes slob pa'i tshul gyis 'doms pas 'jug par bya'o/ /gang na tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems so/ /gang la na sngar ji skad bshad pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsted kyi dbye ba nyer gnyis sgrab pa ste nyams su len pa la'o/ /tshul ji ltar na mi dmigs zhes pa'i shugs la dmigs zhes pa thob pas ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i rtog ngo na spyod pa po byang sems sogs/ kun rdzos kyi bden pa las mi 'darme bas de rnams kun rdzob tu dmigs shing brtags shing dpyad na/ spyod pa po byang

sems sogs don dam pa'i bden pa rang bzhin spos bral las mi 'da' bas spod pa po byang sems/ /spyad 'bras byang chub/ spyad bya yum/ spyod pa rang gi ngo bo zlog zla dang bcas pa deng / shesabya phung po lnga rnams don dam par mi dmigs pa rtogs pa'i sherme rab dang / de ltar mdo zlos/ /shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das byang sems chen pos yum ji ltar sbyad par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe byang sems chen po yod bzhin du byang sems yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / byang sems kyi ming yang / byang chub dang byang chub kyi ming yang / yum dang yum gyi ming yang spyod ces bya bar/ mi spyod ces bya bar/ spyod kyang spyod la/ mi spyod kyang mi spyod ces bya bar spyod pa yang ma yin mi spyod pa yang ma yin par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /gzugs dang /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo zhes gsungs pa bzhin mdo gzhung sprad na/ /mde'i yum la spyod pa'i tshe zhes pa yan gyi don ni bsgrub pa la yan yin la/ byang sems yod bzhin du zhes dngos su gsungs pas phyi rnams la yang / byang chub yod bzhin du/ yum yod bzhin du/ gzugs sogs yod bzhin du/ zhes pa shugs la thob pa rnams kyi don ni

༄༅/ /kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bas shes pa yin la/ byang sems nas rnam par shes pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes pa'i bar gyi don ni don dam pa'i bden pa las mi 'da' bas mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis shes pa yin no/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' yod bzhin du zhes pas kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bas skur pa 'debs pa'i mtha' las 'das par bstan/ byang sems nas rnam par shes pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes pa'i bar gyis don dam par mi dmigs pas sgro 'dogs pa'i mtha' las 'das par bstan to/ /mdor na mdo des mtha' gnyis la mi gnas par yum la spyad par bya'o zhes sam yum la spyod pa na/ spyod pa po dang / spyad 'bras dang / spyad bya dang / spyod pa dang / mi spyod pa dang / spyod mi spyod gnyis ka dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa dang / shes bya la sogs cir yang mi rtog par yum la spyad par bya'o zhes bstan no/ /rnam g.yeng gi rnam rtog bcu'i gnyen po dang sbyor ba dang / 'grel ba'i 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba rnams mang du dogs nas 'dir ma bris la gzhan du bri bar bya'o/ /ched du bya ba dang / sbyor ba dang / rtogs pa rnams nyan thos dang sogs pa rang sangs rgyas dang / thun mong ma yin pa sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'da' ba'i ched du rtogs pa chos sku thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sbyor ba

phar phyin drug rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs te/ de lta bu'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi tshul gyis so/ /de ltar mdo las/ shā ri'i bu phyogs bcu re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di /dge slong shā ri'i bu dang / mo'u 'gal gyi bu lta bu sha stag gis 'di lta ste/ dper na 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ 'od ma'i tshal lam/ bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ spyig ma'i tshal lam/ 'bras kyi tshal lam/til gyi tshal ltar yongs su gang bar gyur kyang de dag gi shes rab gang yin pa des byang sems yum la spyod pa'i shes rab nyin gcig bsgoms pa tsam gyis brgya'i char yang / stong dang / brgya stong dang / bye ba brgya stong nas grangs su yang / char yang bgrang bar yang rgyur yang dper yang / nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /shā ri'i bu de ltar yum la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab nyin gcag bsgom ba gang yin pa des ni/nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes rab zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ri'i bu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab ni sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i slad du nye bar gnas pa yin te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi shes rab ni de lta ma yin no zhes so/ /mdo'i don bkrol na 'dam bu'i tshal la sogs pa dpe drug gis nyan rang gi rtogs pa'i chos drug mtshon

༄༅/ /no / /ji ltar na 'dam bus gnod pa cung zad kyang mi bzod bzhin du nyan rang gi sbyor lam drod kyis kyang las dang nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa cung zad kyang mi bzod pa dang / 'od ma mes sreg pa dang mtshon gyis bcad kyang rtsa ba chad dka' ba bzhin du/ nyan rang gi rtse mo yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i gnod byed drag po dang 'phrad kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba chad par dka' ba ste/ mdzod las/ rtse mo thob pa rtsa mi 'chad / /ces so/ /bu ram shing mngar ba'i rang bzhin las mi 'da' ba bzhin du/ nyan rang gi bzod pa thob nas ngan song du mi skye bar bde 'gror rgyun mi 'chad par chos sgom pa'i mngar ba las mi 'da' ba ste/mdzod las/ bzod thob ngan song yongs mi lhung / /zhes so/ /spyig mas myur du pags pa 'bigs pa bzhin du/ nyan rang gi chos mchog gis myur du bden pa mngon par rtogs par byed pa'i phyir mthong lam rtogs par byed pa dang / 'bru rnams kyi dang po 'bras yin pa bzhin du/ nyan rang gi mthong lam yang nyan rang 'phags pa rnams kyi rtogs pa dang po yin pa dang / til rnams me tog dang dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa 'dra yang nus pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba yod pa bzhin du/ /nyan rang gi sgom lam dgu po yang mthong lam gyis mthong ba'i bdag med la dmigs te/ rgyun du sgom par byed pas bdag med tsam mngon sum du

rtogs pa 'dra yang dus ring du bsgoms pas spangs pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba yod pa yin no/ /mdor na de 'dra ba'i 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas rtogs pa'i chos drug mtshon byed du dpe drug smos so/ /tshal la sogs pa smos pa'i don ci zhe na/ 'dam bu la yang ring thung sogs yod kyang 'dam bu tsam du rigs gcig pa bzhin du drod la yang gang zag gi khyad par gyis dbang po'i khyad par la sogs pa tha dad kyang drod tsam du rigs tha mi dad par shes pa'i don du yin no/ /des gzhan rnams rigs 'gre'o/ /lam zhes pa'i sgra snga ma snga ma smos pa ni dpe phyi ma phyi ma drang ba'i don du yin no/ /tha mar lam zhes smos pa ni 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i dpe gzhan yang drang ba'i bya ba'i don du yin no/ /yum la spyod pa'i shes rab nyin gcig sgom pa'i byang sems gang yin sems dang po bskyed pa'am/ spyod pa la zhugs pa'am/ phyir mi ldog pa'am/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems yin/ de las gzhan pa'i byang sems med pas so zhe na/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems ma yin te/ sa bcu pa nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i phrin las byed tshul sangs rgyas dang mnyams pas dus la ltos mi dgos/ gsum pa yang ma yin te/ sa brgyad pa nas gzhan don rgyun chad pa'i myang 'das bkag cing / gzhan don

༄tsho/ /rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung bas dus la ltos mi dgos/ gnyis pa yang ma yin te/ sa dang po nas nyan rang gi spangs rtogs rdzogs pas dus la ltos mi dgos so/ /des na sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin te/ de so skye yin pas de'i shes rab de nyan rang 'phags pa'i shes rab bas dman nam snyam pa'i dogs pa srid pas de dgag par bya ba'i phyir du dus kyi sgo nas 'phags par bstan no/ /byang sems bzhi ni dang po ni tshogs sbyor na/ gnyis pa ni sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar na/ gsum pa ni dag pa sa na/ bzhi pa sa bcu pa na yod do/ /brgya nas grangs kyi char yang nye bar mi 'gro zhes pa grangs kyi sgo nas kyang 'phags par bstan/ brgya dang stong dang bye ba la sogs pa smos pa ni shes rab mang po'i go rim shes par bya ba'i don du yin no/ /dmigs bsal med par grangs zhes smos pa ni 'dir smos pa las gzhan pa'i grangs gzung ba shes par bya ba'i don du yin no/ /char yang zhes pas mthu ste nus pa'i sbo nas khyad par du 'phags par bstan te/ bra bo mang po yod kyang nas 'bru gcig bskyed pa'i nus pa med pa bzhin no / /bgrang bar yang zhes pas rigs kyi khyad pare bstan te/ byang sems kyi shes rab n+tu rigs la nyan rang gi shes rab bgrang du yang med de dper na mi'i rigs la rta bgrang du med pa bzhin no/ /rgyur yang
